saw_lines: Women replace knickers by fit and feel, then restock the same cut, so the first pair decides whether they come back.

points: Your site shows 65,000+ 5-star reviews, yet 0 of 23 copy ads carry a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust the claim. Open two ads with a named review quote in the first line.
Your site offers subscribe and save plus 30% off three pairs, yet 0 of 23 ads mention either, so a first time buyer has no price reason to act. Lead three new ads with that offer in the first line.

12 of 23 copy ads open on the same line, your first layer should be, so they compete with each other for the same shoppers. Write two openers around the Boden print and high rise cut, and run them against it.

Your site answers the shipping question in its FAQ, yet 0 of 26 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer has no answer before they click. Add one delivery line to new ads, using the answer your FAQ already gives.
